title: vatica odorata subsp. tonkinensis
intro: Vatica odorata subsp. tonkinensis, commonly known as Vietnamese sandalwood, is a subspecies of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae. It is a highly valued plant due to its aromatic wood, which is rich in essential oils and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Vatica odorata subsp. tonkinensis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote a good night's sleep, while its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
